risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Direct impact on consumer spending. The source explicitly cites global economic conditions, inflation, currency fluctuations, and geopolitical instability as factors affecting demand

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Highly competitive apparel retail industry. Gap Inc. operates in a sector with numerous national and international competitors

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policy
risks.score_rationale: Quantified impact: tariffs increased COGS by 1.2 pp in FY2025. The source notes uncertainty regarding changes in U.S. trade policy and new tariffs expected in February 2026

risks.title: Inventory Management
risks.score_rationale: Inventory increased by 7% in FY2025. Effective inventory management is critical to meet demand while minimizing markdowns

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The source mentions uncertainties related to trade policy impacting costs and availability of products manufactured from international sources

risks.title: Brand Reputation and Relevance
risks.score_rationale: The transformation strategy requires strengthening brand relevance to attract customers. Variable performance across brands (Athleta -9% in Comp Sales) illustrates this risk

risks.title: Shrinkage and Theft in Stores
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk in retail operations with a large network of 2,474 stores

ai_positioning.summary: Gap Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025. No references to AI are present in the provided excerpts.
